title: settings dialog: the catalogue of optional features
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026b step RG6.2.11. A list, not a commitment: what else the settings dialog could do, collected while RG6.2 is fresh, for the maintainer to pick from or to close. Written in the plan step. Maintainer, 2026-09-23.
releaseNotes: The catalogue of optional features for the settings dialog is decided: reset and undo were built (#2614) and the "changed only" view is the two windows of #2606; load and save to a file is rejected, because the code of #2606 is what a user keeps; units in the description are rejected, because the model units are the users implicit choice and a unit would be a guess printed as a fact; apply while the dialog is open was already the behaviour. What survives: the same dialog for simulationSettings (#2624, low priority), and remembering the window, which is undecided and now carries the rule that would make it safe - restore the size always, the position only when it still lies inside the virtual desktop.
